---
name: Bug
about: Something is broken (not a missed or wrong verdict)
title: "[bug] "
labels: ["bug"]

## What happened?

What did you do, and what went wrong? Steps to reproduce help a lot.

## What did you expect?

What should have happened instead?

## Setup

- Backend or frontend?
- How did you run it (local `pytest` / `npm test`, Docker compose)?
- Browser / Python / Node versions, if relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets or private personal data are included.
- [ ] I included logs or error text without secrets.
